HOW TO PLAY

Move
Drag on the pad, bottom left.
Ultimate
When the pad's centre glows and shows TAP!, tap it.
Level up
Tap one of the three cards.
Pause
The pause button, top right.
Story
Tap to go on, or SKIP.
Move
WASD or the arrow keys
Ultimate
Space when it's charged
Level up
123 picks a card
Pause
Esc or P
Go on
Enter (story, results, crowns)
Skip story
Esc
Results
Tab switches STATS / BUILD, R plays again
  • Your champion attacks on its own. You move and dodge.
  • Pop monsters, grab the blue gems, level up and pick a card.
  • Warning rings fill up, then hurt: step out in time. Hearts heal you.
  • Stages 1 to 4: survive the timer. Stage 5: beat the guardian. Stage 6: beat the ruler and win the realm's crown.
  • Every crown gives a power that stays with you.
  • Win all five crowns to open the Crown Vault and face the Cyclops King.
